verdict.rationale: Otter documents scheduling its AI Notetaker to automatically join all Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet meetings, which covers automatic capture in broad terms. Nothing in the evidence describes per-meeting-type rules or explicit Google/Outlook calendar connection. Community reports of the bot joining confidential meetings unexpectedly and rejoining after users tried to stop it suggest selective control is weak. Missing for 10: explicit Google/Outlook calendar connection docs, per-meeting-type or rule-based auto-join controls, independent corroboration of reliable selective capture.
